understanding: The attached source distinguishes heartbeat contact refresh, verification vote delivery, and lease consumption. Heartbeat transport success refreshes contact without comparing response terms; ordinary replication, snapshot sending, and pipeline decoding check for a newer response term first. This describes differing evidence production, not a defect or an authority guarantee. The rejected delta is not the merge base; both existing composite surfaces are retained.

behaviors.execution_owner: Independent heartbeat goroutine started by Raft.replicate
behaviors.protocol_context: One followerReplication object and a reusable heartbeat request containing its captured currentTerm
behaviors.trigger: Heartbeat interval expiration or receipt on s.notifyCh
legal_preconditions: Raft.replicate has started the heartbeat goroutine.
implementation_guards: The interval wait and error backoff select on stopCh.
Peer ID and address are copied under peerLock.
A transport error bypasses contact refresh and notifyAll.
writes: s.lastContact under lastContactLock on transport success
external_effects: Sends AppendEntries without assigning predecessor metadata, entries, or commit index.
On transport success, invokes notifyAll with resp.Success.
Emits failed or resumed heartbeat observations.
important_branches: A nil transport error refreshes contact regardless of resp.Success.
This path does not inspect resp.Term or invoke handleStaleTerm.
A transport error causes capped backoff.
replicate defers closure of the heartbeat stop channel; an executing transport call is not canceled by this function.
async_boundaries: Runs independently of ordinary replication and pipeline processing.

cross_activity_effects.A7: Supplies the response Success bit to pending verification futures through notifyAll; caller completion occurs separately.

existing_protections: Transport errors do not refresh contact.
A negative Success bit remains a negative verification input.
Independent execution allows heartbeat processing while ordinary replication is blocked.
unknowns: Concrete transport response correlation and cancellation semantics are not established.
verifyFuture.vote aggregation and late-vote handling are not attached.

behaviors.execution_owner: Replication, pipeline decoder, or heartbeat actor invoking followerReplication.notifyAll
behaviors.protocol_context: The pending verification map of one followerReplication object
behaviors.trigger: Invocation of notifyAll with a Boolean vote input
implementation_guards: notifyLock protects detachment and replacement of the pending map.
writes: Replaces s.notify with an empty map.
Invokes vote on each future in the detached map.
important_branches: An empty map produces no vote calls.
New registrations enter the replacement map.
cleanNotify deletes from the current map and cannot remove an item from an already detached batch.
This helper does not independently validate response context or establish the meaning of its Boolean argument.
async_boundaries: Registration, detachment, and cleanup can occur on different actors.
Voting outside notifyLock can overlap cleanup or new registrations.

cross_activity_effects.A7: Delivers vote inputs to verification futures without itself completing the caller's verification request.

existing_protections: Map access is serialized by notifyLock.
Each invocation processes only its detached batch.
Future voting does not hold the notification-map lock.
unknowns: Future aggregation, duplicate handling, and notification synchronization require verifyFuture.vote source.

behaviors.execution_owner: Main Raft actor executing the leaderLoop lease timer case
behaviors.protocol_context: Latest configuration and current leader replication-state map
legal_preconditions: The main actor is executing leaderLoop.
Each remote voter has an associated replication-state object; this function does not check for a missing object.
implementation_guards: Only Voter entries in configurations.latest count.
A remote voter counts when its contact age is no greater than the captured LeaderLeaseTimeout.
reads: quorumSize derived from the latest configuration
writes: Calls r.setState(Follower) when contacted count is below quorum.
Reschedules the lease timer using the returned maximum counted remote contact age.
external_effects: Emits contact-age metrics and insufficient-contact diagnostics.
important_branches: The check does not inspect response Success, response term, or match index.
Only counted remote contacts contribute to the returned maximum age.
The caller clamps the next check interval to minCheckInterval.
startStopReplication initializes lastContact to time.Now before any peer response.
Ordinary replication, snapshot sending, and pipeline decoding also update the timestamp.
async_boundaries: Replication actors update timestamps concurrently with the main actor.
Individual LastContact reads are locked; the set of peer timestamps is not read atomically.
existing_protections: Uses latest-configuration voter filtering and quorum calculation.
Captures one lease timeout per invocation.
Reads each contact timestamp under its lock.
Insufficient contact invokes the follower transition path.
unknowns: The consumed heartbeat fact is one possible timestamp provenance, not a prerequisite for every lease check.
Other timestamp producers are not yet represented as separate behaviors and facts.
The full Raft.setState wrapper is not attached; transition side effects remain unresolved.
The supplied transfer-worker comment describes this lease as a connectivity mechanism. A stronger read-authority contract is not established.

facts.meaning: For one heartbeat RPC, transport returned nil and the heartbeat actor subsequently wrote the current local time into its followerReplication lastContact field. This establishes a local contact refresh independently of response Success and without a response-term comparison in this path.

identity.actor: The followerReplication object used by the heartbeat goroutine
identity.destination: The peer ID and address copied under peerLock for the RPC
identity.request_context: The reusable heartbeat request with term captured from s.currentTerm
identity.event: The transport-successful RPC and subsequent timestamp write

facts.validity_context: A historical local write assertion, not evidence of replicated-log progress, durable storage, current authority, or positive verification. Lease processing can consume this write's timestamp only while it remains the value read from the same replication object.
facts.durability: Volatile timestamp; no persistence is performed by this producer.
facts.recovery: A newly created replication object receives time.Now as its initial lastContact. That initialization does not reconstruct a previously completed heartbeat.
unknowns: The timestamp does not retain RPC identity, destination, response term, or Success.
Other writers can replace the timestamp without invalidating the historical write assertion.
Elapsed time changes lease eligibility, not whether the historical write occurred.

surfaces.entry_point: Replication heartbeat, pipeline, request construction, and notifyAll
surfaces.reason: Partially interpreted: heartbeat contact refresh and notification-map detachment are mapped. Pipeline sender/decoder ownership, request construction, and acknowledged-match reporting remain to be represented separately. Pipeline submission must remain distinct from response processing. The composite surface is retained.

surfaces.entry_point: Leadership transfer, verification, and leader lease handling
surfaces.reason: Partially interpreted: lease consumption of contact timestamps is mapped. Transfer coordinator, transfer worker, and verification initiation/completion still require distinct actor descriptions; verifyFuture.vote is not attached. Transfer success and verification success are not established facts in this delta. The composite surface is retained.

delta.rationale: Apply only source-supported local additions against audit_spec version 1. Resolve the removal diagnostics by retaining both existing composite surfaces as explicitly partial and deferred, with mapped behavior references and specific remaining work. No parent removal or replacement children are proposed. Global activities and target profile remain unchanged. Contact refresh, vote delivery, and lease consumption remain separate; no normative claim, successful verification fact, or confirmed defect is introduced.

limitations: This delta does not complete either composite surface.
verifyFuture.vote and concrete transport completion semantics remain unavailable.
Initialization and alternate contact writers prevent interpreting every recent timestamp as a heartbeat response.
No executable observation, calibration, or correctness conclusion follows from this descriptive refinement.
